title: Roguelike Celebration 2026 - Preview Event
description:
While the full Roguelike Celebration conference isn’t happening until October, we wanted to provide a space for the community to gather before then. This will be an opportunity to catch up with old friends, meet new ones, and explore our exciting custom-built multiplayer game/chat space! It's totally free, and all you’ll need to attend is a web browser.

For this year's preview event, we're excited to share the following talks:

"Ancient Roguelikes: The Pre-History of Roguelike Games" by Martin Pichlmair
"Bitwise Black Magic: How to Computer, Better Faster Stronger" by Greg L
"Don't Save The @: What Roguelikes Teach Us About Story Structure" by Jamie Brittain
